comment: config with no parameters, inputs or outputs; only a light. The port and the enabled state are saved with the patch. The socket is bound to 127.0.0.1 and handles one client at a time; the protocol is one JSON object per line in and one per line out, with commands for listing and adding modules, cables and parameters and for saving the patch (doc/limen.md). The panel prints only the module name and carries one lamp.
